arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/storage/worktree.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
R=[('skips untracked files over the size limits or matching the exclude globs, and records them','leaves out untracked files matching the exclude globs, and records those over the size limits'),
('''		write(dir, "certs/server.pem", "-----BEGIN-----\\n");
''','''		write(dir, "certs/server.pem", "-----BEGIN-----\\n");
		write(dir, "docs/secrets/a.txt", "secret\\n");
'''),
('exclude: [".env*", "*.pem"] },','exclude: [".env*", "*.pem", "docs/**/a.txt"],\n\t\t\t},'),
('''			".env.local",
			"b.txt",
			"big.dat",
			"certs/server.pem",
		]);''','''			"b.txt",
			"big.dat",
		]);'''),
]
for a,b in R:
    assert a in s,a
    s=s.replace(a,b)
s=s.replace('''{ maxFileBytes: 1024, maxTotalBytes: 1000, exclude''','''{
				maxFileBytes: 1024,
				maxTotalBytes: 1000,
				exclude''')
i=s.index('describe("isExcluded"'); j=s.index('\n});\n',i)+5
s=s[:i].rstrip()+"\n"+s[j:]
s=s.replace('\tisExcluded,\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/worktree.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('skipped: [{ path: ".env", reason: "matches worktree_snapshot_exclude" }],','skipped: [{ path: "big.bin", reason: "over the limit" }],').replace('"`.env` (matches worktree_snapshot_exclude)"','"`big.bin` (over the limit)"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx oxfmt >/dev/null; npm run typecheck 2>&1 | grep error; npx vitest run src/storage src/worktree.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "×|FAIL|Tests "
